crypto_weaknesses_justification: The owned implementations use maintained standard algorithms, but full default-algorithm behavior across every supported optional cloud/provider/legacy transport is not independently established. The strict configuration is not an all-deployment guarantee. https://github.com/open-ott-play/ottplay-control-server/blob/main/docs/quality.md
crypto_keylength_justification: The supported direct-HTTPS server validates its supplied certificate chain, and Go/Android outbound clients check actual verified-chain RSA>=2048, ECDSA>=224 or Ed25519 keys. Python CLI endpoints use OTT_TLS_SECURITY_LEVEL=3, preserving CA/hostname checks while requiring at least 128-bit strength (RSA/DH3072 or EC256). Legacy HTTP is separately documented without a confidentiality claim. https://github.com/open-ott-play/ottplay-control-server/blob/main/docs/security-design.md
crypto_pfs_justification: The supported strong profile has modern ephemeral TLS, but complete forward-secrecy verification across all compatible external peers/deployments has not been established. https://github.com/open-ott-play/ottplay-control-server/blob/main/docs/quality.md
crypto_password_storage_justification: The project does not store external-user password verifiers. Machine credentials have distinct documented handling. https://github.com/open-ott-play/ottplay-control-server/blob/main/docs/security-design.md
